title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Begin with the first loop by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0). Continue with the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.125), then the third line from (0.75, 0.125) to (0.0, 0.125), and finally, the fourth line from (0.0, 0.125) back to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.025 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting dimensions of the rectangular bar are a length of 0.7500000000000001 units, a width of 0.12500000000000003 units, and a height of 0.025000000000000005 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.125) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.125) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.025)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.125) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.125) \

     .close()
